Model Viewer 4.1.0, vendored from the official npm package @google/model-viewer.
Source: https://github.com/google/model-viewer
License: Apache-2.0 (included in model-viewer-LICENSE.txt).
The comparison page uses this standalone ES module without CDN dependencies.
Base is copied byte-for-byte from nymeria_quaternius_pilot.zip.
Peasant and Ranger are copied byte-for-byte from nymeria_fixed_heads.zip
(peasant-with-head.glb and ranger-with-head.glb).
